messages.author: a2c316298c1ee632
messages.subject: shiny app at root url...
parts:
I want to host a single app to appear at http://www.server.com instead of http://www.server.com/myApp

Is this possible. The closest I could find was this config... but it's not it... http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/os/latest/#host-a-single-application

Thanks

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: shiny app at root url...
parts:
Yup; you got it. Sorry the documentation didn't make it clear, but you can use app_dir to host an application at a particular URL. If you use an app_dir inside:

location / {
  app_dir /srv/...;
}

Then you'll be hosting a single application at the base URL.

Jeff
